subject.description: VID of the party being revoked (or scope-reduced).

scopes.description: If present, the specific scopes to remove from the subject's entry. If absent, the entire entry is removed.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale for the revocation.

Response.title: ACL Revoke — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/revoke request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/revoke/0.1#response.

entry.description: The AclEntry the maintainer now holds for the subject. null for a full removal; an AclEntry with reduced scopes for a scope reduction.
